Case studies

The work behind the result.

Every engagement starts with a business problem, not a tool. We look at what is not working, change the part that matters and measure the difference it makes.

Each example below follows the same structure: the context, the problem, what we changed and the result. We publish only numbers a client can evidence.

Case 01 · Customer journey

Laluxrys

Consumer commerce · Mobile customer journey

Consumer commerce business with mobile visitors struggling to complete the journey comfortably.

The problem

The existing mobile experience created friction before high-intent visitors could move into a conversation or purchase decision. The responsive product grid did not hold together on the screens most customers were using.

What we changed

We rebuilt the mobile journey, tested it across the screen sizes that mattered and created a clearer route into a WhatsApp consultation for customers who needed help before buying.

The result

More than 30 qualified enquiries each month after the revised journey was introduced, and a mobile shopping experience that works consistently again.

30+Qualified enquiries each month
MobileConversion experience improved
Relevant services · Websites & web platforms; Integrations & business systems.

“Our mobile shop finally looks and works the way it should.”

Founder, Laluxrys
Case 02 · Automation & AI

Marketing Hub

Internal system · Automation, AI and CRM

A team was spending more than 30 hours each month planning and preparing cross-platform content.

The problem

Planning, drafting and publishing involved too many repeated manual steps, and there was no single place where content planning, publishing and CRM activity came together.

What we changed

We built a connected workflow that plans, drafts and schedules a month of content from a single input, with AI-assisted drafting and CRM synchronisation.

The result

70% of the manual work removed, more than 30 hours returned every month and a week of content prepared in under one hour.

70%Manual work removed
Under 1 hourTo prepare a week of content
30+ hoursReturned every month
Relevant services · Automation & AI; Integrations & business systems; Training & consulting.

“What used to take our team a full week now takes under an hour.”

Case 03 · Website recovery

SearchPath Arabia

Recruitment platform · Website recovery

A recruitment platform whose customer-facing listings had become unreliable to reach.

The problem

The platform experienced a serious website issue that put access to customer-facing listings at risk and needed urgent recovery work.

What we changed

We restored the platform, returned the listings to normal use and completed reliability-focused improvement work on the way the site is maintained.

The result

The platform was restored within 48 hours and returned to supporting more than 100 active job listings, including automated third-party imports.

48 hoursTo restore the platform
100+Listings kept online
Relevant services · Websites & web platforms; Integrations & business systems.
Continuity

A project can end. Improvement should not.

Every case on this page began as a problem somebody had been living with. A poor mobile experience, hours of repetitive manual work or a platform nobody was watching can continue unnoticed when no one is responsible for the systems behind the business.

That is why the work does not have to end at delivery. When ongoing improvement is worth it, we stay involved through a monthly partnership with agreed priorities and a defined capacity.

The pattern

Different symptoms. One missing connection.

Different symptoms. One missing connection.

These cases looked different on the surface, but they shared one issue: the parts of the business that should have been working together were not, and nobody had responsibility for the join.

Dakyworld builds, connects and improves those systems, rather than completing a project and disappearing.
